We also build custom AI solutions, including AI agents and prompt-based services, to automate processes, enhance decision-making, and improve operational efficiency.

custom-software-development.title: Custom Software Development
custom-software-development.body: Bespoke software engineered around your exact workflows, from internal tools and ERPs to customer-facing SaaS products.

cyber-security.title: Cyber Security & Ethical Hacking
cyber-security.body: End-to-end security assessments, penetration testing, and system hardening to protect your business from evolving threats.

industries-services.title: Industries Services
industries-services.body: Industry-specific digital solutions for manufacturing, retail, logistics, healthcare, finance, and the public sector.

data-analytics.title: Data Analytics
data-analytics.body: Turn raw data into business intelligence with modern data platforms, dashboards, and predictive analytics.

ui-ux-designing.title: UI/UX Designing
ui-ux-designing.body: Research-driven interface design that blends clarity, accessibility, and brand identity into delightful digital experiences.

aws-services.title: AWS Services
aws-services.body: Certified AWS architecture, migration, and managed cloud operations built for scale, resilience, and cost efficiency.

web-design-development.title: Web Design & Development
web-design-development.body: High-performance corporate websites, e-commerce platforms, and web applications built with modern frameworks.

ai-agent-service.title: AI Agent Service
ai-agent-service.body: Custom AI agents, prompt-based assistants, and intelligent automation built on modern LLMs and MCP integrations.

export-import.title: Commerce Import & Export
export-import.body: Approvisionnement, fret, douanes et fulfilment de bout en bout.
export-import.details: Yanabiya Gulf facilitates seamless international trade across multiple regions through a trusted network of logistics partners and deep expertise in local compliance. We manage the entire end-to-end value chain, from sourcing and consolidation to shipping, customs clearance, and final delivery, enabling our clients to focus on expanding their markets while we handle operational complexity.

trade-route-planning.title: Trade Route Planning & Sourcing
trade-route-planning.body: Strategic planning of trade corridors and supplier networks to ensure the most efficient, cost-effective routes for your cargo.

freight-forwarding.title: International Freight Forwarding
freight-forwarding.body: End-to-end freight forwarding across sea, air, and land, connecting your shipments to global destinations reliably and on time.

customs-clearance.title: Customs Clearance & Compliance
customs-clearance.body: Expert customs clearance, import/export compliance, and documentation handling to ensure smooth cross-border movement of goods.

warehousing-delivery.title: Warehousing & Last-Mile Delivery
warehousing-delivery.body: Secure warehousing, efficient inventory management, and reliable last-mile delivery solutions tailored to your business needs.

trade-finance.title: Trade Finance & Payment Structuring
trade-finance.body: Advisory services on trade finance instruments and payment structures that reduce risk and improve cash flow across borders.

regulatory-compliance.title: Regulatory Compliance & Documentation
regulatory-compliance.body: Comprehensive handling of cross-border regulatory requirements and trade documentation to keep your shipments compliant.

supply-chain-optimization.title: Supply Chain Optimization
supply-chain-optimization.body: End-to-end supply chain analysis and redesign to reduce costs, shorten lead times, and build resilience into your logistics network.

cargo-consolidation.title: Cargo Consolidation & Coordination
cargo-consolidation.body: Groupage and consolidation services that combine smaller shipments into cost-efficient full loads for international movement.

risk-management-tracking.title: Risk Management & Shipment Tracking
risk-management-tracking.body: Real-time shipment visibility and proactive risk management to protect your cargo and ensure on-time delivery.

vendor-sourcing.title: Vendor Sourcing & Procurement
vendor-sourcing.body: Trusted vendor identification, qualification, and procurement support to build reliable supply partnerships globally.

dropshipping-ecommerce.title: Dropshipping & E-Commerce Fulfillment
dropshipping-ecommerce.body: Seamless dropshipping and e-commerce fulfillment solutions connecting your online store to global customers efficiently.

cold-chain-cargo.title: Cold Chain & Specialized Cargo
cold-chain-cargo.body: Temperature-controlled and specialized cargo handling for perishables, pharmaceuticals, and sensitive goods requiring precise conditions.

order-fulfillment.title: End-to-End Order Fulfillment
order-fulfillment.body: Complete order fulfillment management from purchase order issuance through final delivery, one point of contact for the entire journey.

clothing.title: Vêtements & Accessoires
clothing.body: Marque propre, sourcing textile, contrôle qualité et approvisionnement retail.
clothing.details: Our apparel division connects Bangladesh\u2019s world-class garment manufacturing capabilities with retailers, distributors, and brand partners across key international markets. We manage private-label production, quality assurance, sourcing, and brand collaboration, delivering end-to-end apparel supply chain solutions from factory floor to retail shelf.

private-label-branding.title: Private Label & Branding
private-label-branding.body: End-to-end private-label manufacturing and brand building, from concept and design through production and launch.

bulk-garment-sourcing.title: Bulk Sourcing & Production
bulk-garment-sourcing.body: Reliable bulk garment sourcing and production management, connecting buyers to leading Bangladesh manufacturers.

fashion-accessories.title: Fashion Accessories
fashion-accessories.body: Sourcing and supply of fashion accessories, from bags and belts to jewellery and lifestyle items, across global markets.

quality-assurance.title: Quality Assurance
quality-assurance.body: Rigorous QA and third-party inspection programmes to ensure every shipment meets your brand standards.

oem-odm-manufacturing.title: OEM & ODM Solutions
oem-odm-manufacturing.body: Custom OEM and ODM manufacturing, enabling brands to bring unique designs to market with full production support.

packaging-export.title: Packaging & Export
packaging-export.body: End-to-end packaging, labelling, and export documentation to get your garments shelf-ready worldwide.

seasonal-inventory.title: Seasonal Collections
seasonal-inventory.body: Trend-driven seasonal sourcing and inventory planning to keep your product range fresh and market-responsive.

agents-brokerage.title: Agents & Courtage
agents-brokerage.body: Accords transfrontaliers, partenariats et soutien aux appels d'offres.
agents-brokerage.details: Through our professional brokerage network, we represent suppliers, manufacturers, and institutions across key markets, connecting buyers with the right partners, structuring deals, and supporting transactions from initial engagement to successful closure.

fire-insurance.title: Fire Insurance
fire-insurance.body: Comprehensive fire insurance coverage protecting your property and assets from fire-related damage and losses.

marine-insurance.title: Marine Insurance
marine-insurance.body: Reliable marine insurance covering cargo, vessels, and freight during international and domestic transit.

motor-insurance.title: Motor Insurance
motor-insurance.body: Full motor insurance solutions for personal and commercial vehicles, covering accidents, theft, and third-party liability.

travel-safe-insurance.title: Travel Safe Insurance
travel-safe-insurance.body: Comprehensive travel insurance keeping you protected against medical emergencies, cancellations, and travel disruptions worldwide.

education-insurance.title: Education Insurance
education-insurance.body: Education insurance plans securing your children's academic future regardless of unforeseen circumstances.

health-insurance.title: Health Insurance
health-insurance.body: Flexible health insurance plans providing access to quality medical care for individuals, families, and corporate groups.

personal-accident-insurance.title: Personal Accident Insurance
personal-accident-insurance.body: Personal accident coverage providing financial protection for you and your family in the event of injury or disability.

property-insurance.title: Property Insurance
property-insurance.body: Complete property insurance protecting commercial and residential assets against damage, loss, and liability.

child-protection-plan.title: Child Protection Plan
child-protection-plan.body: Dedicated child protection plans providing financial security and educational guarantees for your children's future.

home-loans.title: Home Loans
home-loans.body: Accessible home loan advisory and facilitation services to help individuals and families secure property financing.

car-loans.title: Car Loans
car-loans.body: Car loan facilitation services connecting customers with competitive vehicle financing options.

personal-loans.title: Personal Loans
personal-loans.body: Personal loan advisory helping individuals access flexible financing for personal needs and financial goals.

office-management.title: Services de Gestion de Bureaux
office-management.body: Bureaux équipés, services PRO, comptabilité et administration.

security-services.title: Security Services

fire-safety.title: Fire Safety
fire-safety.body: End-to-end fire safety services including installation, staff training, and systematic audits to ensure compliance and emergency preparedness.

toll-operations.title: Toll Operations

housekeeping-catering-horticulture.title: Housekeeping, Catering & Horticulture

cctv-network-management.title: CCTV & Network Management Services
cctv-network-management.body: Advanced CCTV surveillance and network management services providing connectivity, security monitoring, and access control across facilities.

office-support-services.title: Office Support Services
office-support-services.body: Comprehensive office support services including mail management, receptionist, training coordination, and employee credential verification.

oms-manpower-services.title: Manpower Services
oms-manpower-services.body: Reliable manpower supply of IT executives, facility staff, medical professionals, drivers, and semi-skilled workers for operational needs.

energy-sustainability.title: Energy Management & Sustainability
energy-sustainability.body: Smart energy management, sustainability audits, and green-building initiatives that lower operating costs and meet ESG compliance targets.

security-guard-manpower.title: Security Guard Service

packaging-manpower.body: Skilled packaging staff for product wrapping, labeling, kitting, and bulk packaging across retail, e-commerce, manufacturing, and export operations.

decor-woodwork-wallpaper-manpower.title: Décor, Woodwork & Wallpaper
decor-woodwork-wallpaper-manpower.body: Skilled decorators, carpenters, and wallpaper installers for residential, commercial, and hospitality fit-out projects.

metal-blacksmith-manpower.title: Metal Structures & Blacksmith
metal-blacksmith-manpower.body: Certified welders, blacksmiths, steel fixers, and metal-structure fabricators for industrial, construction, and infrastructure projects.

yanabiya-commerce.title: Yanabiya e-Commerce
yanabiya-commerce.details: Yanabiya e-Commerce is our proprietary e-commerce vertical delivering end-to-end online retail, multi-platform marketplace management, and digital trade solutions. We operate our own online stores across multiple countries, offering products ranging from garments and accessories to IT hardware and everyday essentials. Our platform handles everything from product listing and payment processing to order fulfilment and after-sales support.

online-retail-store.title: Online Retail Store
online-retail-store.body: Yanabiya-owned storefronts selling garments, accessories, IT hardware, and everyday essentials directly to consumers.

marketplace-management.title: Multi-Platform Marketplace
marketplace-management.body: Selling and managing Yanabiya products across major global marketplaces including Amazon, eBay, and regional platforms.

order-fulfilment.title: Order & Fulfilment Management
order-fulfilment.body: End-to-end order processing, warehouse picking, packing, and last-mile delivery coordination for all e-commerce orders.

digital-payment-solutions.title: Digital Payment Solutions
digital-payment-solutions.body: Secure multi-currency payment gateways, digital wallets, and cross-border payment processing for all Yanabiya e-Commerce transactions.

yanabiya-digital-platform.title: Yanabiya Plateforme Digitale
yanabiya-digital-platform.details: Yanabiya Digital Platform is our in-house ecosystem of web and mobile applications designed to power internal operations, client services, and field management across all Yanabiya Group verticals. From employee management and field operations to customer-facing service portals and business dashboards, our digital platform unifies data, workflows, and communications in one place.

yanabiya-business-app.title: Yanabiya Business App
yanabiya-business-app.body: Core business management app for Yanabiya Group, tracking operations, finance, and performance across all verticals and countries.

customer-service-portal.title: Customer Service Portal
customer-service-portal.body: Client-facing digital portal for service requests, ticket management, and real-time support across all Yanabiya business services.

field-operations-app.body: Mobile app for field staff, supervisors, and site managers to log tasks, track locations, and manage on-ground operations in real time.

hr-payroll-system.body: Centralised HR and payroll platform managing employee records, leave, contracts, and salary processing across all Yanabiya Group countries.

identity.title: Qui nous sommes.
identity.p1: Yanabiya Group est une entreprise mondiale diversifiée originaire d'Al Khuwair, Muscat, opérant aujourd'hui au Royaume-Uni, au Bangladesh et aux États-Unis.
identity.p2: Nous ne fonctionnons pas comme une entreprise à secteur unique. Nous fonctionnons comme une plateforme, où plusieurs entreprises partagent une discipline opérationnelle et un horizon à long terme, tout en restant indépendantes là où elles en ont besoin.
identity.p3: Cette structure permet à un groupe de six secteurs de rester cohérent dans quatre pays. L'innovation, l'exécution et la capacité opérationnelle évoluent ensemble, pas en silos.

principles.title: Ce pour quoi nous nous battons.

mission.title: Pourquoi nous existons
mission.body: Construire, développer et exploiter des entreprises diversifiées avec la technologie, le commerce et la confiance au centre, dans chaque marché que nous pénétrons.

vision.title: Où nous allons
vision.body: Un écosystème mondial de confiance où de nombreuses entreprises partagent une discipline opérationnelle, un ensemble de valeurs et un horizon à long terme.

values.title: Comment nous travaillons
values.body: La qualité avant l'échelle. Les relations avant les transactions. Les personnes avant les processus. Trois règles, appliquées sans exception.

ourStory.heroPara: A decade of building enterprises across four countries, written one relationship, one delivery, one chapter at a time.
ourStory.s03Title: The next decade isn't about more.
ourStory.s03Para: Deeper expertise across our six sectors. Deeper trust with the communities we serve. Deeper connections across the four countries we already call home.
ourStory.s07Para: Profit isn't the only thing we measure. Across every country we operate in, we commit to community welfare programmes, education access, and environmental responsibility, because long-term value isn't built any other way.
ourStory.s08Title: Trusted by enterprises across four continents.
ourStory.s09Para: Whether you're scaling a venture, sourcing a partner, or entering a new market, let's talk about what's possible.
storyLines: Yanabiya a été fondée non pas pour poursuivre le profit, mais pour servir un objectif : connecter les communautés, créer de la valeur et faire du commerce un outil de dignité humaine.
Notre fondateur croyait que les entreprises peuvent être bonnes — pour leurs propriétaires, leurs employés, les communautés qu'elles servent et la planète sur laquelle elles opèrent.
Au fil des années, nous avons traversé des marchés difficiles, des incertitudes géopolitiques et des défis mondiaux. À chaque fois, nos valeurs ont guidé nos décisions.
Nous n'avons jamais cherché à croître pour croître. Chaque expansion que nous avons entreprise était motivée par une véritable opportunité de service.
En Oman, nous avons commencé par faciliter le commerce entre les marchés du Golfe et d'Asie — en construisant des ponts commerciaux là où il n'en existait pas.
Au Royaume-Uni, nous avons établi un hub pour la diaspora — aidant les communautés à accéder à des conseils professionnels, des services financiers et des opportunités commerciales.
Au Bangladesh, nous avons lié les producteurs locaux aux marchés mondiaux, aidant les familles à accéder à des revenus qui changent leur vie.
Aux États-Unis, nous développons des partenariats stratégiques qui ramènent des opportunités vers nos communautés d'origine.

Notre fondation caritative — financée par les bénéfices de nos activités commerciales — a soutenu des écoles, des Masjid, des secours lors de catastrophes et des programmes d'autonomisation des femmes.
Nous croyons que la réussite commerciale et la responsabilité sociale ne s'excluent pas mutuellement. En fait, l'une renforce l'autre.
Chaque partenaire avec lequel nous travaillons, chaque client que nous servons, chaque communauté que nous touchons — ils font tous partie de l'histoire de Yanabiya.
Ce voyage est loin d'être terminé. Nous continuons à construire, à apprendre et à servir — guidés par la foi, animés par l'objectif et enracinés dans l'intégrité.

milestones.title: Fondation à Mascate
milestones.body: Yanabiya est fondée à Mascate, en Oman, avec une petite équipe dédiée aux solutions commerciales transfrontalières pour les marchés du Golfe et d'Asie du Sud.

milestones.title: Expansion au Royaume-Uni
milestones.body: Un bureau au Royaume-Uni ouvre ses portes, établissant notre premier ancrage européen et posant les bases de partenariats mondiaux.

milestones.title: Présence au Bangladesh
milestones.body: Les opérations au Bangladesh démarrent, reliant les exportateurs locaux aux marchés mondiaux et créant des emplois dans les communautés locales.

milestones.title: Lancement de la fondation caritative
milestones.body: La Yanabiya Charitable Foundation est officiellement lancée, canalisant les bénéfices vers l'éducation, les secours d'urgence et les programmes communautaires.

milestones.title: Entrée sur le marché américain
milestones.body: Yanabiya s'implante aux États-Unis, élargissant ses capacités de conseil et forgeant des partenariats stratégiques en Amérique du Nord.

milestones.title: Réseau de 4 continents
milestones.body: Aujourd'hui, Yanabiya opère sur quatre continents avec des équipes en Oman, au Royaume-Uni, au Bangladesh et aux États-Unis, servant des clients dans plus de 20 pays.

OM.body: Where the story began. Our Muscat office anchors group strategy, regulatory intelligence, and Gulf trade operations.

GB.body: A London base for client engagements, partnerships, and regulated advisory work across EMEA.

BD.body: Our engineering and apparel hub. Where craft meets capacity, at scale, with discipline.
